_about: laurel: a 21s feature-drop launch film for a voice / input feature, derived frame-by-frame from a 21.0s motion-designed feature launch (1920x1080 @30fps). Authored on the 1280x720 stage, rendered at device scale 1.5: render.mjs --fps 30 --scale 1.5. Placeholder product: Laurel, adding hands-free dictation. ONE object carries the film: a dark voice pill with live green level bars. A lime brand keycap rises, three grey keys fall in to spell the shortcut, the pill rises in a green glow and knocks them off, drops to the bottom of the frame and stays there while what it hears is TYPED above it: into a chat composer on a torn-paper lilac ground, then as a line beside a rolling app-icon drum, then as a hand-lettered title stack. A hard cut to a lime card draws the mark and types the wordmark.
_sections: S1 0-5.0 keycaps: lime key rises and draws its mark, three grey keys fall and land, pill knocks them off, lime key drops out | S2 2.6-17.3 the voice pill (rise with overshoot and glow, drop and shrink to the bottom at 5.2-6.4, bars live to the end) plus the sound ribbon | S3 4.9-10.2 thread tears open into a lilac wedge, composer pops in, the sentence types, holds, deletes, lilac fades | S4 9.8-14.0 the line slides to centre beside a white tile; app icons roll through it, accelerating; both rise out | S5 14.0-17.3 hand title, serif claim, availability and fine print type in as the stack rises | S6 17.3-21.0 hard cut to lime: mark draws on large, shrinks, wordmark types, lockup centres
_slots: 11 image slots in s4-line `icons` ({src, label} per arrival, a square app icon, png/svg) and the mark slot `markSrc` on s1-keys and s6-endcard (your brand mark, square svg/png). Without them, neutral drawn glyphs and a drawn laurel leaf stand in. Every piece of copy is a field: keys[].word, composer greeting/placeholder/text ([fn] makes a key chip)/chips, line text, title/claim/available/fine, endcard word and colour.
